prompt: Find the top 50 NHL players by career points, only including players with at least 5 seasons.
gold_query: SELECT s.playerID, m.firstName, m.lastName, SUM(s.Pts) as career_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) as seasons FROM Hockey.Scoring s JOIN Hockey.Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID WHERE s.lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY s.playerID, m.firstName, m.lastName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) >= 5 ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find the top 50 Hall of Fame voting results by BBWAA with at least 75% support, showing vote percentages. Give the player's first and last name, the year, the vote percentage.
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, h.yearID, CAST(h.votes AS REAL) / h.ballots * 100 as vote_percentage FROM lahman_2014.halloffame h JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON h.hofID = p.hofID WHERE h.votedBy = 'BBWAA' AND h.ballots > 0 AND CAST(h.votes AS REAL) / h.ballots >= 0.75 ORDER BY vote_percentage DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query: SELECT p.nameFirst AS first_name, p.nameLast AS last_name, h.yearID AS year, (h.votes::DOUBLE / h.ballots) * 100 AS vote_percentage FROM lahman_2014.halloffame h JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON h.hofID = p.hofID WHERE h.votedBy = 'BBWAA' AND h.category = 'Player' AND (h.votes::DOUBLE / h.ballots) >= 0.75 ORDER BY vote_percentage DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find the top 8 pitchers by WHIP. Show the player's first and last name, the year, the innings pitched, and the WHIP.
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, pi.yearID, pi.IPouts / 3 as innings_pitched, (pi.BB + pi.H) / (pi.IPouts / 3.0) as WHIP FROM lahman_2014.pitching pi JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON pi.playerID = p.playerID WHERE pi.IPouts >= 150 ORDER BY WHIP ASC LIMIT 8
submitted_query:
SELECT p.nameFirst AS first_name,
       p.nameLast AS last_name,
       pi.yearID AS year,
       (pi.IPouts/3.0) AS innings_pitched,
       ((pi.BB + pi.H) / (pi.IPouts/3.0)) AS WHIP
FROM lahman_2014.pitching pi
JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON pi.playerID = p.playerID
WHERE pi.IPouts > 0
ORDER BY WHIP ASC
LIMIT 8

prompt: List each constructor-season combination where the constructor scored more than 100 total points, for seasons after when points systems became comparable. Show the constructor name, year, and total points. Aggregate points from individual race results.
gold_query: SELECT c.name AS constructor, ra.year, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year >= 2010 AND r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, ra.year HAVING SUM(r.points) > 100

prompt: Find the top 50 session beers by ABV. Note: ABV is stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%). I'd like to see their name, abv, style, and brewery name.
gold_query: SELECT b.name as beer_name, b.abv, b.style, br.name as brewery FROM CraftBeer.beers b JOIN CraftBeer.breweries br ON b.brewery_id = br.id WHERE b.abv < 0.05 AND b.abv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.abv DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query:
SELECT b.name, b.abv, b.style, br.name AS brewery_name
FROM CraftBeer.beers b
JOIN CraftBeer.breweries br ON b.brewery_id = br.id
WHERE b.abv < 0.05
ORDER BY b.abv DESC
LIMIT 50;

prompt: Find countries with small populations (< 100,000) - economic data for these may be unreliable. Exclude countries with population = 0. Show their name, population, and gross national product.
gold_query: SELECT c.Name, c.Population, c.GNP FROM world.Country c WHERE c.Population < 100000 AND c.Population > 0
submitted_query: SELECT Name, Population, GNP FROM world.Country WHERE Population > 0 AND Population < 100000 ORDER BY Population

prompt: Calculate transaction statistics (total deposits, total deposit amount, and average deposit amount).
gold_query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_deposits, SUM(amount) as total_deposit_amount, AVG(amount) as avg_deposit_amount FROM financial.trans WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' AND amount >= 1000 AND k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND k_symbol != 'UROK' AND date >= '1995-01-01'

prompt: Find the top 10 batters (name, year) by batting average (H/AB).
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, b.yearID, CAST(b.H AS REAL) / b.AB as batting_avg FROM lahman_2014.batting b JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE b.AB >= 100 ORDER BY batting_avg DESC LIMIT 10

prompt: List major cities along with their country information.
gold_query: SELECT ci.Name as city_name, ci.Population, co.Name as country_name, co.Continent, co.Region FROM world.City ci JOIN world.Country co ON ci.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE ci.Population > 2000000

prompt: Find the top 30 constructors with the highest number of races where at least two cars started.
gold_query: SELECT c.name as constructor, COUNT(DISTINCT r1.raceId) as races_at_least_two_started FROM ErgastF1.results r1 JOIN ErgastF1.results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId AND r1.constructorId = r2.constructorId AND r1.resultId < r2.resultId JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r1.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE r1.grid > 0 AND r2.grid > 0 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name ORDER BY races_at_least_two_started DESC LIMIT 30

prompt: For beers missing IBU data, impute a value of 20 (typical for lagers/wheat beers) and calculate average IBU by style.
gold_query: SELECT b.style, AVG(COALESCE(b.ibu, 20)) as avg_ibu_imputed FROM CraftBeer.beers b GROUP BY b.style
submitted_query: SELECT style, AVG(COALESCE(ibu, 20)) AS avg_ibu FROM CraftBeer.beers GROUP BY style

prompt: Find the top 30 F1 drivers by podium finishes.
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) as podium_finishes FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 AND r.position <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY podium_finishes DESC LIMIT 30

prompt: List the top 50 capital cities by population, along with their countries.
gold_query: SELECT co.Name as country, ci.Name as capital_city, ci.Population FROM world.Country co JOIN world.City ci ON co.Capital = ci.ID WHERE ci.Population IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ci.Population DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find the top 50 statements by net amount.
gold_query: SELECT c.statement_no, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code != 'RF' THEN c.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) as gross_charges, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN c.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) as refunds, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code != 'RF' THEN c.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN c.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) as net_amount FROM Credit.charge c WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 GROUP BY c.statement_no ORDER BY net_amount DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query:
SELECT s.statement_no,
       s.statement_dt,
       s.statement_amt,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END), 0) AS net_amount
FROM Credit.statement AS s
LEFT JOIN Credit.charge AS c ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no
GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt
ORDER BY net_amount DESC
LIMIT 50

prompt: Compare current average salaries between 'Legacy' and 'Recent' workforce.
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN e.hire_date < '1990-01-01' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Recent' END as cohort, AVG(s.salary) as avg_salary FROM employee.employees e JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.hire_date < '1990-01-01' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Recent' END HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
submitted_query:
WITH latest_salary AS (
    SELECT s.emp_no, s.salary
    FROM employee.salaries s
    JOIN (
        SELECT emp_no, MAX(to_date) AS max_to
        FROM employee.salaries
        GROUP BY emp_no
    ) m ON s.emp_no = m.emp_no AND s.to_date = m.max_to
)
SELECT CASE WHEN e.hire_date < DATE '1990-01-01' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Recent' END AS workforce,
       AVG(ls.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM latest_salary ls
JOIN employee.employees e ON ls.emp_no = e.emp_no
GROUP BY workforce;

prompt: What is the on-time performance percentage for each unique airline carrier? Round the percentage to 2 decimal places.
gold_query: SELECT UniqueCarrier, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) as on_time_percentage FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL AND Cancelled = 0 AND Diverted = 0 AND (WeatherDelay IS NULL OR WeatherDelay = 0) GROUP BY UniqueCarrier

prompt: Find the top 50 non-reliever pitchers by ERA (Earned Run Average). Show the player's first and last name, the year, the innings pitched, and the ERA.
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, pi.yearID, pi.IPouts / 3 as innings_pitched, (pi.ER * 9.0) / (pi.IPouts / 3.0) as ERA FROM lahman_2014.pitching pi JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON pi.playerID = p.playerID WHERE pi.IPouts >= 150 ORDER BY ERA ASC LIMIT 50
submitted_query:
SELECT p.nameFirst AS first_name,
       p.nameLast AS last_name,
       pi.yearID AS year,
       pi.IPouts/3.0 AS innings_pitched,
       pi.ERA
FROM lahman_2014.pitching AS pi
JOIN lahman_2014.players AS p ON pi.playerID = p.playerID
WHERE pi.GS > 0               -- started at least one game (non‑reliever)
  AND pi.IPouts > 0           -- pitched some innings
ORDER BY pi.ERA ASC
LIMIT 50;

prompt: Count accidents by administrative unit, only for units with more than 100 accidents for statistical significance.
gold_query: SELECT n.upravna_enota, COUNT(*) as accident_count FROM Accidents.nesreca n GROUP BY n.upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
submitted_query: SELECT ue.ime_upravna_enota AS administrative_unit, COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM Accidents.nesreca n JOIN Accidents.upravna_enota ue ON n.upravna_enota = ue.id_upravna_enota GROUP BY ue.ime_upravna_enota HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

prompt: Find the top 50 NHL players by average goals per season, only including players with at least 5 seasons.
gold_query: SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName, CAST(SUM(s.G) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) as avg_goals_per_season, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) as seasons FROM Hockey.Scoring s JOIN Hockey.Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID WHERE s.lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY s.playerID, m.firstName, m.lastName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_goals_per_season DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query: SELECT playerID, COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS seasons, SUM(G) AS total_goals, AVG(G) AS avg_goals_per_season FROM Hockey.Scoring GROUP BY playerID HAVING seasons >= 5 ORDER BY avg_goals_per_season DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find all origin/destination airport pairs that are thin routes. How many such pairs are there?
gold_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS thin_route_count FROM (SELECT Origin, Dest FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Origin, Dest HAVING COUNT(*) < 50) thin_routes

prompt: List 'high-gravity' beers along with their brewery information and abv. Note: ABV is stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.095 for 9.5%).
gold_query: SELECT b.name as beer_name, b.abv as abv_percent, b.style, br.name as brewery_name, br.city, br.state FROM CraftBeer.beers b JOIN CraftBeer.breweries br ON b.brewery_id = br.id WHERE b.abv >= 0.095 ORDER BY b.abv DESC

prompt: Identify the top 30 microbreweries with the smallest beer catalogs.
gold_query: SELECT br.id, br.name, COUNT(b.id) as beer_count FROM CraftBeer.breweries br JOIN CraftBeer.beers b ON br.id = b.brewery_id GROUP BY br.id, br.name HAVING COUNT(b.id) < 3 ORDER BY beer_count ASC, br.name LIMIT 30

prompt: Find country names where the sum of language percentages exceeds 100% due to multilingualism.
gold_query: SELECT co.Name FROM world.Country co JOIN world.CountryLanguage cl ON co.Code = cl.CountryCode GROUP BY co.Name HAVING SUM(cl.Percentage) > 100
submitted_query: SELECT c.Name FROM world.Country c JOIN world.CountryLanguage cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code GROUP BY c.Name HAVING SUM(cl.Percentage) > 100

prompt: Compare average salaries by gender for current employees.
gold_query: SELECT e.gender, AVG(s.salary) as avg_salary FROM employee.employees e JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01' GROUP BY e.gender HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
submitted_query:
SELECT e.gender, AVG(s.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employee.employees e
JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY e.gender
ORDER BY e.gender

prompt: How many employees are part of the 'legacy workforce'?
gold_query: SELECT COUNT(*) as legacy_workforce_count FROM employee.employees WHERE hire_date < '1990-01-01'

prompt: Calculate the current headcount by department based on their current department assignment, counting each employee only once based on their most recent department assignment. Be sure to return departments by name, not id.
gold_query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) as headcount FROM employee.dept_emp de JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND de.emp_no NOT IN (SELECT emp_no FROM employee.dept_manager WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01') GROUP BY d.dept_name
submitted_query:
SELECT d.dept_name AS department, COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employee.dept_emp de
JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no
WHERE de.to_date = DATE '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY d.dept_name

prompt: Find the default rate for loans.
gold_query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('B') THEN 1 END) as default_rate_pct FROM financial.loan
submitted_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('C','D'))::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'B'), 0) AS default_rate FROM financial.loan

prompt: Analyze completed flights by day of week for January 2016. Give total flights, on-time flights, and average delay in minutes by day of week.
gold_query: SELECT DayOfWeek, COUNT(*) as total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time_flights, AVG(ArrDelayMinutes) as avg_delay FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL AND Cancelled = 0 AND Month = 1 GROUP BY DayOfWeek

prompt: Find the top 50 countries by population density. Show names and densities.
gold_query: SELECT c.Name, CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea as population_density FROM world.Country c WHERE c.Population > 0 AND c.SurfaceArea > 0 ORDER BY population_density DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query: SELECT Name, (Population / SurfaceArea) AS density FROM world.Country WHERE SurfaceArea > 0 AND Population IS NOT NULL ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find the top 25 members (member_no, first name, last name, and net_charge_volume) by net charge volume, where refunds (charge_code 'RF') are subtracted from gross charges.
gold_query: SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END) as net_charge_volume FROM Credit.member m JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY net_charge_volume DESC LIMIT 25
submitted_query:
SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END) AS net_charge_volume
FROM Credit.member m
JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no
GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname
ORDER BY net_charge_volume DESC
LIMIT 25

prompt: What is the count of diverted flights by route (origin-destination pair), including only routes with more than 5 diversions?
gold_query: SELECT Origin, Dest, COUNT(*) as diverted_count FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE Diverted = 1 GROUP BY Origin, Dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
submitted_query:
SELECT Origin, Dest, COUNT(*) AS diversions
FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1
WHERE Diverted = 1
GROUP BY Origin, Dest
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY diversions DESC

prompt: Find the top 3 F1 rookie drivers ordered by their start count (highest first) then surname (descending).
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) as career_starts FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) < 20 ORDER BY career_starts DESC, d.surname DESC LIMIT 3

prompt: List countries by continent with their dominant languages where language percentage exceeds 90%, showing whether each language is official.
gold_query: SELECT co.Continent, co.Name as country, cl.Language, cl.Percentage, cl.IsOfficial FROM world.Country co JOIN world.CountryLanguage cl ON co.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.Percentage > 90
submitted_query:
SELECT c.Continent,
       c.Name AS Country,
       cl.Language,
       cl.IsOfficial,
       cl.Percentage
FROM world.Country c
JOIN (
    SELECT CountryCode,
           Language,
           IsOfficial,
           Percentage,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rn
    FROM world.CountryLanguage
) cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
WHERE cl.rn = 1
  AND cl.Percentage > 90
ORDER BY c.Continent, c.Name;

prompt: Identify 'super users' by id in the movie ratings data, showing the number of ratings they've given.
gold_query: SELECT u.userid, COUNT(*) as ratings_given FROM imdb_MovieLens.u2base u GROUP BY u.userid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

prompt: Find beers with 'extreme' bitterness. Return the beer name, IBU, style, and brewery name.
gold_query: SELECT b.name as beer_name, b.ibu, b.style, br.name as brewery_name FROM CraftBeer.beers b JOIN CraftBeer.breweries br ON b.brewery_id = br.id WHERE b.ibu > 100
submitted_query:

       COALESCE(b.ibu, 20) AS ibu,

       br.name AS brewery_name

prompt: What is the total amount of performing loans by district name?
gold_query: SELECT d.A2 as district_name, SUM(l.amount) as total_loan_amount FROM financial.district d JOIN financial.account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN financial.loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.status = 'A' AND d.district_id != 1 GROUP BY d.A2

prompt: What are the top three openings by games played? Count games separately for each opening_id (do not deduplicate by name).
gold_query: SELECT o.name as opening_name, COUNT(*) as game_count FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%' GROUP BY o.opening_id, o.name ORDER BY game_count DESC LIMIT 3
submitted_query: SELECT opening_id, COUNT(*) AS game_count FROM Chess.game GROUP BY opening_id ORDER BY game_count DESC LIMIT 3

prompt: Find the top 30 driver names by fastest lap time.
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(lt.milliseconds) as fastest_lap_ms FROM ErgastF1.lapTimes lt JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE lt.milliseconds >= 60000 GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY fastest_lap_ms ASC LIMIT 30
submitted_query:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
FROM ErgastF1.lapTimes l
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY driver_name
ORDER BY fastest_ms ASC
LIMIT 30;

prompt: Calculate the loan portfolio size by status for each loan classification. Show the loan classification, count, and total amount.
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'Performing' WHEN status = 'B' THEN 'Watch List' WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Non-Performing' END as loan_classification, COUNT(*) as loan_count, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM financial.loan GROUP BY CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'Performing' WHEN status = 'B' THEN 'Watch List' WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Non-Performing' END
submitted_query:
SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'Performing' WHEN status = 'B' THEN 'Watch List' ELSE 'Non-Performing' END AS loan_classification,
       COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
       SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM financial.loan
GROUP BY loan_classification
ORDER BY loan_classification

prompt: Find salary statistics for departments where salary statistics can be reported. Show me employee count and average salary by department name.
gold_query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) as employee_count, AVG(s.salary) as avg_salary FROM employee.dept_emp de JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no JOIN employee.employees e ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND s.to_date = '9999-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) >= 5

prompt: Find providers with fewer than 100 total charges that should be aggregated as 'Long tail providers'. I want to see the provider number and the charge count.
gold_query: SELECT p.provider_no, COUNT(*) as charge_count FROM Credit.charge c JOIN Credit.provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 AND c.charge_code != 'RF' GROUP BY p.provider_no HAVING COUNT(*) < 100
submitted_query: SELECT provider_no, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM Credit.charge GROUP BY provider_no HAVING COUNT(*) < 100

prompt: Calculate the average transaction value.

prompt: Identify the top 30 members (first, last) by cumulative lifetime charges.
gold_query: SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(c.charge_amt) as lifetime_charges FROM Credit.member m JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_code != 'RF' AND c.charge_amt != 0.01 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY lifetime_charges DESC LIMIT 30

prompt: Identify production breweries that should be analyzed separately.

prompt: Find the top 50 starting pitchers by games started, showing their season statistics. I want to see the player's first and last name, the year, the games started, the innings pitched, and the earned runs.
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, pi.yearID, pi.GS as games_started, pi.IPouts / 3 as innings_pitched, pi.ER FROM lahman_2014.pitching pi JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON pi.playerID = p.playerID WHERE pi.GS > 0 AND pi.IPouts >= 150 ORDER BY pi.GS DESC LIMIT 50

prompt: Find countries (names and codes) with multiple official languages. Show the language count.
gold_query: SELECT co.Code, co.Name, COUNT(cl.Language) as language_count FROM world.Country co JOIN world.CountryLanguage cl ON co.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE cl.IsOfficial = 'T' GROUP BY co.Code, co.Name HAVING COUNT(cl.Language) > 1

prompt: Calculate total points by constructor and year for each season from when points systems became comparable.
gold_query: SELECT c.name as constructor_name, ra.year, SUM(r.points) as total_points FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 AND ra.year >= 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, ra.year
submitted_query:
SELECT c.name AS constructor, r.year, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
FROM ErgastF1.constructorStandings cs
JOIN ErgastF1.races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.year >= 2010
GROUP BY c.name, r.year
ORDER BY r.year, total_points DESC

prompt: Find district names (A2) with fewer than 50 accounts that should be aggregated as 'Other' for reporting, as well as their account counts.
gold_query: SELECT d.A2 as district_name, COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count FROM financial.district d LEFT JOIN financial.account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 HAVING COUNT(a.account_id) < 50

prompt: Count the number of beers missing IBU data that should be flagged for data quality analysis.
gold_query: SELECT COUNT(*) as missing_ibu_count FROM CraftBeer.beers b WHERE b.ibu IS NULL

prompt: Group charges by spending type. Show the spending_type, charge_count, and total_amount.
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Essential' WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'Discretionary' ELSE 'Other' END as spending_type, COUNT(*) as charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) as total_amount FROM Credit.charge c WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 AND c.charge_code != 'RF' GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Essential' WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'Discretionary' ELSE 'Other' END
submitted_query:
SELECT c.category_desc AS spending_type,
       COUNT(*) AS charge_count,
       SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_amount
FROM Credit.charge ch
JOIN Credit.category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no
GROUP BY c.category_desc
ORDER BY spending_type

prompt: Show carrier performance with counts of on-time, moderately delayed, and severely delayed flights.

prompt: Calculate win rates for White players (with at least 5 games). Return the 30 players with the highest win rates, ordered by win rate descending.

submitted_query:

       COUNT(*) AS total_games,
       SUM(CASE WHEN game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_rate

prompt: Compare Mercedes teammate performance in the 2015 F1 season, showing race-by-race position comparisons where both drivers finished. Return raceId, year, constructor name, driver1 surname, driver2 surname, driver1_pos, and driver2_pos.
gold_query: SELECT r1.raceId, ra.year, c.name as constructor, d1.surname as driver1, d2.surname as driver2, r1.position as driver1_pos, r2.position as driver2_pos FROM ErgastF1.results r1 JOIN ErgastF1.results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId AND r1.constructorId = r2.constructorId AND r1.driverId < r2.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d1 ON r1.driverId = d1.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON r1.constructorId = c.constructorId JOIN ErgastF1.races ra ON r1.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE r1.position IS NOT NULL AND r2.position IS NOT NULL AND r1.position > 0 AND r2.position > 0 AND ra.year = 2015 AND c.name = 'Mercedes'
submitted_query:
WITH mercedes_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, surname FROM ErgastF1.drivers WHERE surname IN ('Hamilton','Rosberg')
),
mercedes_results AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, res.constructorId, res.driverId, res.position
  FROM ErgastF1.results res
  JOIN ErgastF1.races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2015
    AND res.constructorId = (SELECT constructorId FROM ErgastF1.constructors WHERE name = 'Mercedes')
    AND res.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM mercedes_drivers)
    AND res.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  mr1.raceId,
  r.year,
  c.name AS constructor_name,
  d1.surname AS driver1_surname,
  d2.surname AS driver2_surname,
  mr1.position AS driver1_pos,
  mr2.position AS driver2_pos
FROM mercedes_results mr1
JOIN mercedes_results mr2 ON mr1.raceId = mr2.raceId AND mr1.driverId <> mr2.driverId
JOIN ErgastF1.races r ON mr1.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN ErgastF1.constructors c ON mr1.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d1 ON mr1.driverId = d1.driverId
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d2 ON mr2.driverId = d2.driverId
WHERE d1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND d2.surname = 'Rosberg'
GROUP BY mr1.raceId, r.year, c.name, d1.surname, d2.surname, mr1.position, mr2.position
ORDER BY mr1.raceId;

prompt: For each ECO code, show the game count, white wins, black wins, and draws. Only include ECO codes with at least 5 games.
gold_query: SELECT g.ECO, COUNT(*) as game_count, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as white_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '0-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as black_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1/2-1/2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draws FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%' AND g.ECO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.ECO HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
submitted_query:
SELECT ECO,
       COUNT(*) AS total_games,
       SUM(CASE WHEN game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS white_wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN game_result = '0-1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS black_wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN game_result = '1/2-1/2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draws
FROM Chess.game
GROUP BY ECO
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY ECO
